entries.title: Remember is on the mode bar for everyone
entries.body: Remember, the mode for testing what you took from an article, no longer needs the Experimental features switch. Its Recall, Tutorial and Quiz views are there for every reader. One more view, Explore, is still experimental: it is shown when Experimental features is turned on on your profile page.

entries.title: Fuller summaries scale with the article's length
entries.body: In Summary, the Fuller level is now asked to run to about 250, 500, 700 or 900 words, depending on how long the article is, so a short essay gets a shorter summary and a book a longer one. These are the lengths asked for, not guaranteed ones. Brief is unchanged, and summaries already written are not rewritten.

entries.title: Very long documents can get an AI-written Structure
entries.body: A very long document, such as a book, used to get only an outline built from its own headings. Structure now tries to have the AI write the sections, working through the document in parts. If that does not succeed, you get the headings-based outline as before.
